That current Extension Pack source still includes both searchInclude and searchRevInclude contexts.
reconciliation: No FHIR-core source was changed. The requested contexts are present in the current Extension Pack source, and any future context-list edit belongs in HL7/fhir-extensions rather than the core checkout.
